modelAsset.surfaceType: One adult body with an older standing-reference contour correction and one persistent feather atlas. One skinned fan of twelve white tail feathers.
modelAsset.changes: Fuller stance and folded-wing contour fitted to the older standing model. A shared feather atlas derived from that reference. A rebuilt feather fan on the existing tail joint.
modelAsset.biology: Evidence-linked sequence for posture transitions. Angles, distances, elapsed time and ground contacts are authored display values.

viewerRig.type: One adult rig with wing and hindlimb articulation
viewerRig.scope: Ground takeoff, airborne flapping and glide, shallow bank, flat-surface landing and standing. Comparative evidence informs phase order.
viewerRig.description: One body, feather atlas, feet and tail across standing, takeoff, flight and landing. A continuous folded-wing contour correction and articulated tail fan.

modelAsset.retainedUVScope: The body retains the prior UV coordinates. The revised plumage atlas includes feather pigments from the older standing reference. The layered tail has its own UVs.
